testsuite.name: com.chromascape.web.aiplayer.prototype.FishingShadowDecisionServiceTest

testcase.name: run discovery tolerates an incomplete trailing line from an interrupted append
persisted and in-memory ranges merge: first is minimum, last and count are maximum
run discovery survives a newly opened run before its first tick
an evaluation resolved against a closed generation cannot publish into the reuse
a duplicate first tick cannot change the inventory baseline
the decision model id comes from the snapshot, not a separate fetch
every abstention reports meaningful latency
history is returned newest-first and respects the limit
duplicate and stale ticks remain ignored after cleanup
missing required state produces ABSTAIN_INVALID_STATE
run discovery includes only the legacy file with nullable fields
an out-of-order tick cannot change counters or the latest decision
movement produces ABSTAIN_MOVING
all three feature flags enforce the shadow-only gate
run discovery tolerates an empty run file
history tolerates an incomplete trailing line from an interrupted append
repeated concurrent append/read loops never fail history reads
history treats a malformed completed line as corruption
status for an explicit session returns only that exact active session
cleanup completing first suppresses publication, counters, and enqueue
a non-fishing semantic target abstains
history is valid JSONL and path traversal is rejected
animation or non-idle state produces ABSTAIN_BUSY
status remains internally consistent while the active model changes concurrently
missing spot, plane mismatch, and excessive distance preserve their reasons
an incomplete nested position falls back to valid flat coordinates
session cleanup removes baselines and counters
status reads are safe during concurrent evaluation
a persisted decision carrying the legacy control_allowed field still parses
duplicate and out-of-order ticks do not corrupt latest state or history
control enabled prevents inference
status exposes the extended persistence counters
idle state with a visible matching spot produces INTERACT_NPC
history never fails while decisions are being appended concurrently
cleanup remains idempotent when explicit stop and disconnect both invoke it
the first in-memory decision supplies firstTick and firstObservedAt
the baseline is reset for the new generation of a reused session id
publication holding the session lock makes cleanup wait
a target NPC that does not match the prediction abstains
run summaries with nullable timestamps serialize cleanly through the controller mapper
missing active model produces ABSTAIN_NO_ACTIVE_MODEL
status reports the activation state/error when no model is active
run discovery includes the legacy file alongside active and historical runs
persistence failure does not stop tick processing
a later decision changes only the last metadata
run discovery treats a malformed completed line as corruption
an unsupported fishing option abstains
run discovery merges an active run with its historical file and sorts newest first
status without a session id reports no inferred session state
an invalid live session ID creates no file and returns no decision
reusing a session id obtains a different generation
old-run cleanup cannot close a newer run and tick zero is accepted with no history merge
the inventory baseline is captured on the first valid tick even without an active model
